title: Is just an overpriced reminders app.
body:
It is literally just a glorified reminder tool. Doesn’t do anything different to the iPhone reminders app, which is free. 
Compared to other (cheaper) apps on the market, it doesn’t come out looking good. Other apps connect apple health and track your steps automatically, lets you add journal entries, monitors your sleep hours etc.
overpriced and under delivers massively.

title: Improvement fact
body:
If you want to improve something you need to manage it, and if you want manage something you need to measure it.

If you can measures it you can improve it.

This is what all is this app about.

I was shocked when i knew how many of my  what i call good habits is not truly habits.

You can also use it count how many day you didn’t do a bad habits like “shishah”

One more thing i used the app for is to track the things that help to improve my good habits, like i find out that in the days I marked my day “weakup before 6 AM” i have a higher chance to hit the “gym”, 

the days where I stuck to healthy launch, i more likely to smoke , 

so it kind of show what are the things that helps you do your good habits or avoid bad habits.

title: Honest Review
body:
Dear Developers, 

I thank for such an amazing app and the efforts you people have put in, I love the design of the app and the functionality. But, if the app has more functionality to it, I think it is going to be a better app. 

I would love to see

Habit Tracker
- More visuals and infographics
- habit sharing and tracking with friends
- Bad Habit Tracker
- Goal Streak
- Dashboard with graphics
